notable_absence.finding: This page states the statistics schema resets on every node restart ('The statistics detailed in this schema are reset at each node restart — they are not persisted') but never states any stat category it deliberately omits from collection - unlike tool:cbcollect-info's own explicit non-support statements. This is consistent with the sgcollect-info.json finding: Sync Gateway's own diagnostic surfaces (both the collection tool and this metrics format) are documented as bounded-positive inventories, never as bounded-negative exclusions, in contrast to cbcollect_info's documented exclusions on the Server side.

cross_component_finding: This page's per-database `gsi_views` GSI Valid Query Names list ('resync', 'tombstones', 'sequences', 'principals', 'channels', ...) is effectively a name-indexed cross-reference into this whole batch's own vocabulary: 'resync' names sgw:resync-operation (resync.json), 'tombstones' names sgw:tombstone (managing-tombstones.json) and 'channels' names sgw:channel (promoted). This is a case where a reference-style page (this one) independently confirms, through its own enumerated query-name list, that the procedural concepts minted elsewhere in this batch correspond to real internal query/monitoring surfaces rather than being purely documentation artifacts.
cross_product_finding: None stated on this page - entirely Sync-Gateway-internal metrics enumeration, with an explicit link to https://golang.org/pkg/runtime/#MemStats for the Go-runtime-level memory stats, but no comparison to Couchbase Server's own stats surfaces.
